warnings: Cast-in-place slab details, one entry per mark; each bar row is a bar_layers[] entry with its printed text ('ตรง สลับคอม้า' = straight bars alternating with bent-up bars). On S1/S2/S3 the two top-bar callouts end in a HANDWRITTEN 'เสริมพิเศษ' (extra top bars at the supports); read as such, both rows kept. Top bars extend 0.80 = 0.2L from each support (printed '0.80 / 0.2L').
Slab thicknesses read from the rotated vertical ticks: S1 0.14, S2 0.12, S3 0.12, S4 0.15, RS1 0.08, S0 0.08.

S4 is the only slab detailed in deformed bars (DB12); the sheet box says 'เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อย ทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40' (third S-sheet with the same 'ทั้งหมด' wording: S-05, S-07, S-08) - so S4's DB12 is SD40 by this sheet, while the architect's A-02 note covers only >=16 mm (see หน้า03_notes.json). Both S4 top rows are printed 'เสริมพิเศษทางยาว' (the second one probably meant ทางสั้น) - kept as printed.
S2 has no slab mark on the second-floor plan S-03 and S3 none on S-02 (S-02 marks S0/S1/S2/S4/HC, S-03 marks RS1/S3/HC); each mark is recorded here as detailed, the plan files say where they sit.

G0 and G1 sections (stair-2 support beams, ground floor) are printed only here (S-10 has none), so they are recorded as full beam specs: G0 0.15x0.40 2-DB16 / 2-DB16 ST-ø6mm@0.15m., G1 0.20x0.40 3-DB16 / 2-DB16 ST-ø6mm@0.15m. They join the G0/G1 segments of the S-02 beam plan. 'ST-ø6mm' = stirrup, ø = RB (spec section 6).

Stair 2 (บันได 2, the outside entrance stairs at the stair boxes on S-02): 5 treads 0.30 and 5 risers 0.15 (= 0.75 total rise, counted on the rotated tick row), waist 0.10 m, two bar rows ø9mm@0.15m., spanning from G0 to the floor beam, 1.60 printed from G0's outer face to the column line. No mark beyond 'บันได 2', so element_id 'บันได 2' as printed (precedent house 170 'บันได 1').

Grid sweep: every number on this sheet is a member-internal size (thickness, bar extent 0.80/0.60, tread/riser, beam 0.15/0.20 x 0.40, stair 1.60) - member-detail sheet, nothing goes to x/y lines (section 4 rule 4 exception).
